caption:
11월 24일(현지) 외신 보도 기준 원재료 뉴스 1건.

1) 멕시코 Tyasa, 신규 특수강봉강(SBQ) 제강 설비 상업 생산 개시…이달 약 5,000~6,000톤 출하, 6개월 내 월 10,000~12,000톤, 2028년 말 월 20,000톤 목표. 멕시코 SBQ 생산능력 연 약 70만 톤 vs 소비 약 200만 톤

구매 관점은 의견이며, 정확한 내용은 각 원문을 확인하세요.

evidence: Tyasa started commercial production at its new special bar quality (SBQ) steelmaking facility in November
“We’re going to be delivering close to 5,000 tonnes, hopefully 6,000 tonnes this month,” Chahin said.
The company expects to increase monthly deliveries to 10,000-12,000 tonnes over the following six months,
with a longer-term target of reaching 20,000 tonnes per month by the end of 2028.
Tyasa had originally planned to bring the facility online earlier in 2026, but the commercial launch was postponed.
The company has been conducting production trials since June and has already delivered some material,
